branches.cn: 这个词从时间滑向转折，结束一个说法再把它拐弯。

branches.en: A short word covering both duration and contrast shows how one root can bend.
branches.cn: 一个短词兼管持续与转折，说明一个词根可以怎样弯折。

intro.en: Yet works alone as adverb and conjunction, and appears in a few fixed phrases worth learning whole.
intro.cn: yet 单独作副词和连词，也出现在几个值得整块记住的固定说法里。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor for the word; Latin marked the same idea with adhuc and tamen.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语用 adhuc 与 tamen 表达同样的意思。

items.example: The train has not yet arrived.
As yet there is no news.
He forgot the key yet again.
That was his quickest run yet.
items.exampleCN: 那是他至今跑得最快的一次。

items.example: Latin adhuc means up to this point.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 adhuc 意为「到此刻为止」。

definition_zh: 拒绝；不肯接受；（名词）垃圾；废弃物
definition_en: to say that you will not do or accept something; (noun) unwanted material that is thrown away
core_image: 背转身去伸出的手：东西递过来，他收回双手扭开头
scene: 门口推销员把传单递过来，男孩摇摇头背过身。 The boy refused to take the flyer at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 refused 是「拒绝、不肯」（第 1 个义项：拒绝做某事）；句意为男孩在门口拒绝接过传单。画面里可留意：伸出的手、摇头的动作、转过去的背。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「拒绝；回绝」
动词加施动者后缀，义为「拒绝者」（较少用）

senses.title: To say no to an action or request
senses.definition: to say firmly that you will not do something that someone asks or wants
senses.definitionCN: 明确表示不肯做别人要求或希望的事
senses.example: She refused to answer any questions without a lawyer.
senses.exampleCN: 没有律师在场，她拒绝回答任何问题。
senses.why: The Latin root means to pour back; refusing is figuratively 'pouring back' the request, returning it unaccepted.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根义为「倒回去」；拒绝好比把递来的请求原样「倒回去」，不接受、不承接，于是成为本义。

senses.title: To not accept something offered
senses.definition: to not accept something that is offered or given to you
senses.definitionCN: 不接受别人提供或给予的东西
senses.example: He refused the money because it felt like a bribe.
senses.exampleCN: 他拒收那笔钱，因为那像是贿赂。
senses.why: The same pouring-back image applies to objects: what is offered flows back to the giver.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「倒回去」的画面也适用于实物：递来的东西又被「倒」回给递出者，形成拒收义。

senses.title: To not give something that is wanted
senses.definition: to not allow someone to have something they ask for
senses.definitionCN: 不答应给别人想要的东西
senses.example: The officials refused them entry without tickets.
senses.exampleCN: 没有票，工作人员不让他们入场。
senses.why: Refusing can point the other direction: instead of pushing back what comes to you, you hold back what others ask from you.
senses.whyCN: 拒绝也可以反向发生：不是把收到的推回去，而是把别人来要的东西扣住不给，于是产生「不予」义。

senses.title: Unwanted material thrown away (noun)
senses.definition: material that is no longer wanted and is thrown away, read as /ˈrefjuːs/
senses.definitionCN: 不再需要而被丢弃的材料，重音前移读作 /ˈrefjuːs/
senses.example: Plastic refuse was piled along the river bank.
senses.exampleCN: 塑料垃圾堆在河岸边。
senses.why: What has been 'poured back' by everyone is finally rejected as worthless; the rejected stream becomes refuse.
senses.whyCN: 被所有人「倒回去」、拒收的东西最终成了无用之物；这条被拒的「流」沉淀为名词 refuse，即垃圾。

intro.en: Refuse flows from Latin refluxere through Old French, keeping the image of something poured back.
intro.cn: refuse 经由拉丁语与古法语一路流变，核心意象始终是「倒回去的东西」。

items.en: refluxare / refundere family: re- (back) + fundere (to pour), 'to pour back'.
items.cn: 拉丁语 re-（回）+ fundere（倒、流），义为「倒回去」。

items.en: Old French refuser meant 'to reject, refuse'.
items.cn: 古法语 refuser 意为「拒绝；否决」。

items.en: The verb entered English in the 14th century meaning to decline or reject.
items.cn: 动词在十四世纪进入英语，表示拒绝、不接受。

items.en: The noun sense of rejected, worthless material developed in Middle English from the same image.
items.cn: 「被拒之物」的名词义也出自同一意象，在中古英语期形成。

items.en: The stress split settled: refuse (verb) on the second syllable, refuse (waste) on the first.
items.cn: 现代英语中重音分化：动词 refuse 重音在后，名词 refuse（垃圾）重音在前。

note.en: These neighbours of refuse differ in strength or direction of the refusal.
note.cn: 下列词与 refuse 在拒绝的强度或方向上有所差别。

entries.definition: the act of refusing
entries.definitionCN: 拒绝；回绝（refuse 的名词形式）

entries.definition: shelter or protection from danger
entries.definitionCN: 庇护；避难（拼写与名词 refuse 极近，词义毫无关联）

entries.definition: a person forced to flee their home
entries.definitionCN: 难民（与 refuse 拼写相近但不同源义）

entries.definition: to refuse politely
entries.definitionCN: 婉拒；谢绝（语气更客气）

entries.definition: to throw back as not good enough
entries.definitionCN: 否决；摒弃（更强调判为不合格）

entries.definition: to refuse to admit or give
entries.definitionCN: 否认；拒绝给予（对象多为说法或权利）

normalIntro.en: Root-based reminders for refuse.
normalIntro.cn: refuse 的词根式记忆提示。

normal.en: re- (back) + fus (pour): pour the offer back to the giver.
normal.cn: re-（回）+ fus（流）：把递来的东西「倒」回去，即拒绝。

normal.en: Same root family as fluent, fluid, influence — all about flowing.
normal.cn: 与 fluent、fluid、influence 同属「流动」词族。

normal.en: Verb stress: reFUSE; noun stress: REFuse (waste).
normal.cn: 动词重音在后 reFUSE；名词（垃圾）重音在前 REFuse。

normal.en: refusal is the noun twin: a flat refusal = a firm no.
normal.cn: refusal 是它的名词孪生：a flat refusal 即断然拒绝。

normal.en: Compare reject: re- (back) + ject (throw), a harsher throw-back.
normal.cn: 对照 reject：re-（回）+ ject（扔），是更用力的「扔回去」。

abstract.en: Picture water poured from your cup straight back into the pot.
abstract.cn: 想象杯中的水被原样倒回壶里——拒绝就是倒回去。

abstract.en: See a closed door with hands folded: the request never enters.
abstract.cn: 看见一扇关着的门与合起的双手：请求进不来。

abstract.en: Imagine a heap of returned parcels beside the river: that is refuse.
abstract.cn: 想象河边一堆被退回的包裹：那便是垃圾 refuse。

examples.en: She refused to sign the contract without reading it first.
examples.cn: 没有先读完合同，她拒绝签字。

examples.en: The city sends two trucks for refuse collection every morning.
examples.cn: 这座城市每天早上派两辆卡车清运垃圾。

examples.en: He politely declined the invitation, but flatly refused the bribe.
examples.cn: 他客气地谢绝了邀请，却断然拒绝了贿赂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞福斯」——「瑞」雪送来的「福」也被「撕」掉退回去：把好事退回去就是拒绝；联想 refused＝退回去了。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）+ fundere（倒、流），「倒回去」→ 拒绝；被众人倒回去之物 → 垃圾。名词动词重音分化：动词 /rɪˈfjuːz/，名词 /ˈrefjuːs/。

sensesIntro.en: From pouring back a request, to pushing back an offer, to holding back a gift, to the pile of what nobody accepts.
sensesIntro.cn: 从倒回去请求，到退回实物，到扣住不给，再到无人接收的废弃物，一条「回流」主线贯穿四义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pouring back what comes
core.cn: 核心意象：把递来的东西倒回去

branches.en: Saying no to a requested action.
branches.cn: 对被要求的事说不（义项 01）。

branches.en: An offered object flows back to the giver.
branches.cn: 递来的实物被退回（义项 02）。

branches.en: Holding back what others ask for.
branches.cn: 别人来要的东西不予（义项 03）。

branches.en: What is refused and worthless accumulates as waste.
branches.cn: 被拒且无用之物堆积成垃圾（义项 03、04）。

branches.en: Denial of action and rejection of object share one image.
branches.cn: 拒绝做事与拒收实物同出一源（义项 01、02）。

intro.en: Refuse carries the Latin pour-structure re- + fus.
intro.cn: refuse 携带拉丁语「倒流」结构 re- + fus。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives from fundere (to pour).
latinIntro.cn: 来自 fundere（倒、流）的拉丁同族词。

items.meaning: to pour together and mix up

definition_zh: 屏幕；银幕；屏风；筛查；遮挡
definition_en: a flat surface showing images, the cinema, a protective panel, to examine for suitability, or to hide something
core_image: 黑暗的客厅里，电视屏幕忽然亮起，映出一张脸
scene: 手机屏幕在黑暗的房间里亮了起来。 The phone screen lit up in the dark room.
sceneCN: 这里 screen 是「屏幕」（第 1 个义项）；句意：手机屏幕在黑暗的房间里亮了起来。

derivatives.zh: 筛查；放映
电影剧本
屏幕保护程序
防晒霜

senses.title: A display surface
senses.definition: a flat surface on which images or words are shown
senses.definitionCN: 显示图像或文字的平面
senses.example: The phone screen lit up in the dark room.
senses.exampleCN: 手机屏幕在黑暗的房间里亮了起来。
senses.why: The central modern sense is the surface that shows images.
senses.whyCN: 核心现代义是显示图像的表面。

senses.title: The cinema
senses.definition: the large screen in a cinema, or film as a medium
senses.definitionCN: 电影院的大银幕，或作为媒介的电影
senses.example: The film was shown on a big screen.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影在大银幕上放映。
senses.why: The display surface stands for the medium shown on it.
senses.whyCN: 显示表面代指在其上呈现的媒介。

senses.title: A protective panel
senses.definition: a piece of material used to block view, wind, or light
senses.definitionCN: 用于挡视线、挡风或遮光的材料
senses.example: A folding screen divided the room.
senses.exampleCN: 一扇屏风把房间隔开。
senses.why: The oldest sense is something that stands in front.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是挡在前面的东西。

senses.title: To examine for suitability
senses.definition: to check people or things to decide if they are suitable or safe
senses.definitionCN: 检查人或物以判断是否合适或安全
senses.example: Doctors screen patients for the disease.
senses.exampleCN: 医生为病人筛查这种疾病。
senses.why: A screen separates what passes from what does not.
senses.whyCN: 筛子把通过者与不通过者分开。

senses.title: To hide from view
senses.definition: to protect or hide something behind a screen
senses.definitionCN: 把某物挡在遮蔽物后面以保护或隐藏
senses.example: Clouds screened the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 云层遮住了太阳。
senses.why: The panel sense becomes the act of blocking.
senses.whyCN: 遮蔽物义转变为遮挡动作。

intro.en: Screen comes from Old French escren, a screen or shield, probably from Middle Dutch scherm.
intro.cn: screen 源自古法语 escren（屏风、遮挡物），可能来自中古荷兰语 scherm。

items.en: Scherm meant a shield or protection.
items.cn: scherm 意为盾牌或保护物。

items.en: Escren meant a screen against heat or view.
items.cn: escren 意为挡热或挡视线的屏风。

items.en: Screen named a panel that blocks view or wind.
items.cn: screen 指遮挡视线或风的屏风。

items.en: Screen came to mean a surface for showing images.
items.cn: screen 开始指显示图像的表面。

items.en: Screen also means to examine or to hide.
items.cn: 现代英语中 screen 还表示筛查或遮挡。

note.en: Screen is compared with similar-looking words and with words for displays and filters.
note.cn: 把 screen 与形近词以及表示显示和筛选的词作比较。

entries.definition: to cry out loudly
entries.definitionCN: 尖叫

entries.definition: a flow of water or data
entries.definitionCN: 水流；数据流

entries.definition: loose stones on a slope
entries.definitionCN: 山坡碎石

entries.definition: an electronic surface showing information
entries.definitionCN: 显示屏

entries.definition: a screen used with a computer
entries.definitionCN: 显示器

entries.definition: to remove unwanted parts
entries.definitionCN: 过滤

normalIntro.en: Screen began as a shield and now names displays and filtering.
normalIntro.cn: screen 起初是遮挡物，现在指显示屏与筛选。

normal.en: A screen shows images.
normal.cn: 屏幕显示图像。

normal.en: The big screen means the cinema.
normal.cn: the big screen 指电影院。

normal.en: A screen can block wind or light.
normal.cn: 屏风可以挡风或遮光。

normal.en: To screen patients is to test them.
normal.cn: 筛查病人就是检测他们。

normal.en: Sunscreen screens the skin from the sun.
normal.cn: 防晒霜为皮肤遮挡阳光。

abstract.en: A screen both shows and hides.
abstract.cn: 屏幕既展示，也遮蔽。

abstract.en: The idea of a barrier links panels, displays, and filters.
abstract.cn: 屏障概念连接了屏风、显示屏与筛子。

abstract.en: To screen is to decide what may pass.
abstract.cn: 筛查就是决定什么可以通过。

examples.en: The film was shown on a big screen.
examples.cn: 这部电影在大银幕上放映。

examples.en: Doctors screen patients for the disease.
examples.cn: 医生为病人筛查这种疾病。

examples.en: Clouds screened the sun.
examples.cn: 云层遮住了太阳。

dict_mnemonic.text: screen 原指挡风的屏风，后来指隔开视线的平面，再指电视与手机屏幕；「筛查」义来自「用筛子隔开」。

root: 源自古法语 escren（屏风、遮挡物），来自中古荷兰语 scherm，核心义「挡在面前的一层」。

sensesIntro.en: Screen means a display surface, the cinema, a protective panel, to examine, or to hide something.
sensesIntro.cn: screen 意为显示屏、电影、屏风、筛查，或遮挡。

core.en: A surface that shows, hides, or separates.
core.cn: 用于显示、遮蔽或分隔的表面。

branches.en: A surface that shows images.
The cinema as a medium.
A panel that blocks view or wind.
Testing and hiding both separate something.
branches.cn: 筛查与遮挡都在分离某物。

branches.en: A screen can reveal and conceal at once.
branches.cn: 屏幕可以同时呈现与遮蔽。

intro.en: Screen forms words for films, devices, and protection.
intro.cn: screen 构成表示电影、设备与保护的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Old French escren is the source; there is no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 escren 是词源，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: The windows were screened from view.

items.meaning: a test or a film showing
an image shown on an idle screen

items.example: The story returned to the big screen.

definition_zh: 完成；完整的；全部的；彻底的
definition_en: to finish making or doing something, or describing something with all its parts
core_image: 拼图的最后一块落到位
scene: 放学后他终于把航模装好了。 The puzzle is now complete with one thousand pieces.
sceneCN: 这里 complete 是「完整的」（第 2 个义项：各部分齐全）；句意是这幅千片拼图如今完整了。

derivatives.zh: 由 complete 加 -ly 构成，义为「完全地；彻底地」
由 complete 加 -ion 构成，义为「完成；结束」
由 in- 加 complete 构成，义为「不完整的」

senses.title: To finish something you are doing
senses.definition: to finish making or doing something so it is ready
senses.definitionCN: 把某事做完，使其可以交付
senses.example: She completed her homework before dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭前她做完了作业。
senses.why: The prefix com- means thoroughly and plere means to fill: fill it up fully and it is done.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 com- 表示「彻底」，词根 plere 意为「填满」，填满了就完成了。

senses.title: Having all necessary parts
senses.definition: having every part that is needed
senses.definitionCN: 所有需要的部分都在的
senses.example: This is a complete set of chess pieces.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一套齐全的国际象棋棋子。
senses.why: What is filled to the brim lacks nothing, so it is whole.
senses.whyCN: 被填满的东西毫无欠缺，因此是完整的。

senses.title: Total and without exception
senses.definition: used to stress that something is total, as in complete silence
senses.definitionCN: 强调某情况达到顶点，如一片寂静
senses.example: The classroom fell into complete silence.
senses.exampleCN: 教室里一片寂静。
senses.why: Fullness pushed to the limit becomes absoluteness.
senses.whyCN: 满到极点就成了绝对。

senses.title: To make something whole by filling in
senses.definition: to add what is missing so a form or set is finished
senses.definitionCN: 补上缺少的部分使表格或成套物完整
senses.example: Complete the form with your name and class.
senses.exampleCN: 在表格里填上姓名和班级。
senses.why: Filling a gap is the very act the Latin root describes.
senses.whyCN: 补上缺口正是拉丁词根所描述的动作。

intro.en: Complete comes from Latin words for filling up fully.
intro.cn: complete 来自拉丁语「填满」的词根。

items.en: Latin plere meant to fill, seen in plenty and supply.
items.cn: 拉丁语 plere 意为填满，见于 plenty、supply。

items.en: Latin complere meant to fill up entirely.
items.cn: 拉丁语 complere 意为完全填满。

items.en: Old French complir kept the finishing idea.
items.cn: 古法语 complir 保留了「做完」之义。

items.en: Middle English completen meant to finish or make whole.
items.cn: 中古英语 completen 指做完或使完整。

items.en: Modern English complete works as both verb and adjective.
items.cn: 现代英语 complete 兼作动词与形容词。

note.en: The first group collects the ple family; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收 ple 词族，第二组收近义词。

entries.definition: Totally and fully.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「完全地」，与 complete 同根。

entries.definition: The act of finishing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「完成」，同根词。

entries.definition: Not having all parts.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不完整的」，是 complete 的反义词。

entries.definition: Something that completes or pairs well.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补充；补足」，拼写相近但意思不同。

entries.definition: To bring to an end.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「完成；结束」，较口语。

entries.definition: Whole and full.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「整个的；全部的」。

entries.definition: Complete with nothing missing.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「完整的」，与 complete 第二义相近。

normalIntro.en: Remember complete through filling up and finishing.
normalIntro.cn: 从「填满」与「做完」两个角度记 complete。

normal.en: com- means fully and -plete means fill.
normal.cn: com- 表示彻底，-plete 表示填满。

normal.en: plenty, supply and complete share the root.
normal.cn: plenty、supply 与 complete 同词根。

normal.en: complete and incomplete are opposites.
normal.cn: complete 与 incomplete 是反义词。

normal.en: A complete set has nothing missing.
normal.cn: 一整套东西毫无缺漏。

normal.en: complete and complement differ by only one letter.
normal.cn: complete 与 complement 只差一个字母。

abstract.en: See the last puzzle piece click into place.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一块拼图咔哒落位。

abstract.en: Watch water rise to the brim of a glass.
abstract.cn: 看着水满到杯口。

abstract.en: Hear a long note fade into total silence.
abstract.cn: 听一个长音完全归于寂静。

examples.en: Complete the exercises on page ten tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚完成第十页的练习。

examples.en: Her stamp album is now complete after two years.
examples.cn: 两年后她的集邮册终于收齐了。

examples.en: There was complete silence when the film began.
examples.cn: 电影开始时全场一片寂静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「坎普利特」——露营把装备填得「坎普利特」，一样不少，complete 就是完整、完成。

root: 拉丁语 com-（彻底）+ plere（填满）→ complere（完全填满）→ 古法语 complir → 中古英语 completen → 现代英语 complete；同族词有 plenty（充足）、supply（供应）、complement（补足）。

sensesIntro.en: Complete runs from filling up to finishing, wholeness and absolute totals.
sensesIntro.cn: complete 从填满走向完成、完整与绝对彻底。

definition_zh: 服务；公共设施；服役；维修；发球
definition_en: work done for others, a public system such as transport, military duty, the act of maintaining a machine, or a tennis serve
core_image: 清晨的公交车准时停靠，车门打开，乘客依次上车
scene: 顾客对这里的服务非常满意。 The customers are very happy with the service.
sceneCN: 这里 service 是「服务」（第 1 个义项）；句意：顾客对这里的服务非常满意。

derivatives.zh: 可用的；耐用的
维修
损害；帮倒忙

senses.title: Work for others
senses.definition: work done to help customers or others
senses.definitionCN: 为顾客或他人提供的帮助性工作
senses.example: The customers are very happy with the service.
senses.exampleCN: 顾客对这里的服务非常满意。
senses.why: This is the core modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代核心义。

senses.title: Public system
senses.definition: a system that supplies a public need
senses.definitionCN: 满足公共需求的系统
senses.example: The bus service runs every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 公交服务每小时一班。
senses.why: Service expands from people to systems.
senses.whyCN: 服务从人扩展到系统。

senses.title: Military duty
senses.definition: time spent in the armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 在军队中度过的时间
senses.example: He completed his military service.
senses.exampleCN: 他完成了兵役。
senses.why: Serving the state includes military duty.
senses.whyCN: 为国家服务包括服兵役。

senses.title: Maintenance
senses.definition: the act of checking and repairing a machine
senses.definitionCN: 检查与修理机器的行为
senses.example: He took his car in for service.
senses.exampleCN: 他把车送去维修。
senses.why: Keeping a machine working is a service.
senses.whyCN: 保持机器运转是一种服务。

senses.title: Tennis serve
senses.definition: the act of starting play by hitting the ball
senses.definitionCN: 击球开始比赛的动作
senses.example: Her service won the game.
senses.exampleCN: 她的发球赢下了这一局。
senses.why: The opening stroke is also named service.
senses.whyCN: 开球动作也叫 service。

intro.en: Service comes from Latin servitium, service or slavery, from servus, slave.
intro.cn: service 出自拉丁语 servitium（服务、奴役），源于 servus（奴隶）。

items.en: Servus meant slave or servant.
items.cn: servus 意为奴隶或仆人。

items.en: Servitium meant service or slavery.
items.cn: servitium 意为服务或奴役。

items.en: Old French servise kept the service sense.
items.cn: 古法语 servise 保留了服务义。

items.en: English service covered work, worship, and duty.
items.cn: 英语 service 涵盖工作、礼拜与职责。

items.en: It extended to public systems and maintenance.
items.cn: 它扩展到公共设施与维修。

note.en: Service is compared with similar-looking words and with words for help and systems.
note.cn: 把 service 与形近词以及表示帮助与系统的词作比较。

definition_zh: 竞争；比赛；对抗；媲美
definition_en: to try to win or gain something against others
core_image: 多条跑道上的选手同时冲向同一条终点线
scene: 运动会上，四个班的接力队都盯着冠军奖杯。 Our relay team will compete against Class Two on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 compete 是「比赛」（第 1 个义项：为获胜而较量）；句意是周五我们接力队将和二班比赛。

derivatives.zh: 由 compete 加 -ition 构成，义为「比赛；竞争」
由 compete 加 -or 构成，义为「竞争者；选手」
由 compete 加 -itive 构成，义为「竞争激烈的；好胜的」

senses.title: To take part in a contest
senses.definition: to join a game, race or match to win
senses.definitionCN: 为获胜而参加比赛、赛跑或对抗
senses.example: She will compete in the 100-metre race.
senses.exampleCN: 她将参加一百米赛跑。
senses.why: Runners share one finish line, so each tries hardest.
senses.whyCN: 选手共享同一条终点线，所以人人竭尽全力。

senses.title: To try to win something others want
senses.definition: to try to get the same prize, job or customers as others
senses.definitionCN: 与他人争取同样的奖品、职位或顾客
senses.example: Two shops compete for the students' pocket money.
senses.exampleCN: 两家商店争夺学生们的零花钱。
senses.why: What is limited must be fought for fairly or unfairly.
senses.whyCN: 有限的东西必然被争夺。

senses.title: To be as good as
senses.definition: to be good enough to match someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 好到足以与某人某物相比
senses.example: No local dish can compete with Mum's dumplings.
senses.exampleCN: 没有任何馆子能与妈妈包的饺子媲美。
senses.why: Matching another's quality is a quiet kind of contest.
senses.whyCN: 比得上对方的质量，是一场无声的较量。

intro.en: Compete means to seek together — competitors aim at the same goal.
intro.cn: compete 本义是「共同寻求」——竞争者瞄准同一目标。

items.en: Latin competere meant to come together, agree or strive in common.
items.cn: 拉丁语 competere 意为共同来到、一致或共同争取。

items.en: It joins com- (together) and petere (to seek, to rush at).
items.cn: 它由 com-（一起）和 petere（寻求、冲向）构成。

items.en: Later Latin used it for rivals aiming at one prize.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语用它表示瞄准同一奖项的对手。

items.en: English borrowed compete in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪借入 compete。

items.en: Sport and business gave the word its modern heat.
items.cn: 体育与商业赋予该词现代的火药味。

note.en: The petere family and contest words.
note.cn: petere 词族与竞赛之词。
